t.E141.agn: In 2015 EFSA could not complete the safety assessment because data on absorption, long-term effects and reproduction were lacking, and it recommended withdrawing the existing ADI; it reported that the purity criteria needed updating.
t.E141.body: Some components of copper chlorophyllins are absorbed from the gut.
t.E141.eff.0.t: EFSA could not complete the safety assessment because data on absorption, long-term effects and reproduction were lacking
t.E141.prod: Obtained by chemical treatment, adding a copper salt to a plant extract.
t.E141.regx.0: The assessment could not be completed owing to lack of data; withdrawal of the ADI was recommended.
t.E141.summary: A copper-stabilised form of chlorophyllin; it gives a more stable green colour. It is used in canned vegetables, confectionery and ice cream.
